citations.title: BNP Paribas Gets ECB Query Over Succession Plan for CEO Bonnafe - Bloomberg

sentences.quote: BNP Paribas SA has been asked by the European Central Bank to explain its plans for a smooth management transition when it replaces long-term Chief Executive Officer Jean-Laurent Bonnafe.
sentences.text: In July 2026 the European Central Bank asked BNP Paribas to set out its plans for a smooth transition when it replaces long-serving chief executive Jean-Laurent Bonnafe, as part of its annual capital-requirements exercise, also covering other top roles including the chairmanship held by Jean Lemierre.

Sandro Pierri, head of BNP Paribas Asset Management, joined the group Executive Committee on 30 March 2026, reporting to deputy chief operating officer Renaud Dumora, with management framing the unit under the 2030 strategic plan as a growth engine working more closely with the CPBS and CIB businesses.

sentences.quote: Group net banking income (NBI) came to EUR 14,091m, up by 12.0% compared to the second quarter of 2025.
sentences.text: BNP Paribas combines corporate and institutional banking, commercial and personal banking and investment and protection services, and group net banking income reached EUR 14,091m in the second quarter of 2026, up 12.0% year on year.

sentences.quote:
Confident in exceeding 2026 targets, with double-digit EPS and net income CAGR (>10%) expected from 2025-2028.
Return on tangible equity expected to exceed 13% in 2028.
sentences.text: Management targets net income and EPS compound annual growth above 10% from 2025 to 2028 and a return on tangible equity above 13% in 2028.
An enhanced efficiency programme lifted the annual cost savings target to EUR 1bn from EUR 700m, with a cost-income ratio below 56% targeted by 2028.

sentences.quote: Achieved CET1 ratio of 13% (+20 bps QoQ), reaching the 2027 target 18 months ahead of schedule
sentences.text: The 13% CET1 target was reached 18 months ahead of schedule, and a minimum 60% payout policy applies from 2027.
The AXA IM integration took assets under management in investment and protection services to EUR 2,590bn, with asset management pre-tax income set to double by 2030.

thesis_pillars.text: BNP Paribas combines corporate and institutional banking, commercial and personal banking and investment and protection services, and group net banking income reached EUR 14,091m in the second quarter of 2026, up 12.0% year on year. Management targets net income and EPS compound annual growth above 10% from 2025 to 2028 and a return on tangible equity above 13% in 2028. The 13% CET1 target was reached 18 months ahead of schedule, and a minimum 60% payout policy applies from 2027.
